Name: Kneazle's Three Broomsticks - Wizarding World(Harry Potter) Based Horse Retexture
Author: hushkneazle
Description:
[center][b]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/o3ITCOD.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿


[i][color=#ffd966]Here comes 【 Kneazle's Three Broomsticks 】![/color][/i][/b][/center][center]

If you are a wizard who turned into a farmer,

You must've been plagued by the absence of magic broomstick in Stardew Valley.

Then you should see what this little black kneazle brought for you folks.

I hope you can enjoy it!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/yXtP5xX.png[/img]﻿

0. You need to download [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu﻿[/url]﻿ to use this mod.

1. Download the attached file named [b]'Kneazle's Three Broomsticks'[/b] and unzip it in your [b][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/b] folder.

2. Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].

3. Adjust your custom setting at config menu.

4. Enjoy your flying in Stardew Valley!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/PaCFge5.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GVZhcWc.jpg[/img]﻿
﻿


[b]Horse to Broomstick[/b] : You can on/off the retexture on your horse.

[b]Broomstick[/b] : You can choose your broomstick among three options.
[i]( nimbus 2000, nimbus 2001, firebolt )[/i]

[b]Horse Flute to Golden Snitch[/b] : You can on/off the retexture on your horse flute.

[b]Golden Snitch[/b] : You can choose your golden snitch's wing color between two options.
[i]( gold wings, silver wings )[/i]

[b]Bodyshape[/b] : If you are using specific bodyshape mod, you need to adjust this option to it.
[i]( now only available for vanilla, [url=http://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's peach body type[/url]﻿. )
[/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/7bMrlno.png[/img]﻿﻿


There's one more mod for detail-oriented wizard!

As you are all aware, the sound of golden snitch is actually not as melodical as a horse flute.

This other mod [b][color=#ffd966]- Kneazle's Golden Snitch Sound -[/color][/b]

will change the sound of your golden snitch realistically!

[i](Sound Effect Source from : [/i][url=http://youtu.be/BVpTxpaz1Es?si=fu-8WmUo7RwEW9Vm]The Audio Horizon SFX[/url]﻿[i])[/i]


0. You need to download [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to use this mod.

1. Download the attached file named [b]'Kneazle's Golden Snitch Sound'[/b] and unzip it in your [b][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/b] folder.

2. Run the game using SMAPI.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/3S50hRS.png[/img]﻿﻿

It is highly recommended to use this mod with the following mod :

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21020]No Hoof Sound
[/url]﻿


﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/b5uIoDc.png[/img]﻿

[b][color=#ffd966][u]My retextures and mods are prohibited from being modified and redistributed without my permission.[/u][/color][/b]
(If you want to modify it [b][i]for personal use[/i][/b], please contact me first.)

This is my first mod, so there might be some inexperience.
Please feel free to let me know if there is anything I need to fix.

I've only checked it work on the PC version, so I don't know if it would be suitable for the mobile and other console's version.
Sorry for not being helpful.

Should you have any inquiries, you can contact me with [url=http://www.patreon.com/c/kneazle]Patreon[/url]﻿:
which is the fastest way.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/8foWyM4.png[/img]﻿

Please let me know how was your experiences with this mod!

And if you can afford it... it's also a good idea to give this little black kneazle a yummy.

[url=http://ko-fi.com/kneazle]Ko-fi[/url]﻿ 💛
﻿
﻿[/center]
